description: Teacher domain + mock data layer (profile, live-lessons subscription with checkout/verify, chat), the Teacher Chat screen (MVI) and HomeRoute.TeacherChat wired in HomeEntryProvider, plus tabs/teacher/di/TeacherModule.kt included by homeModule. Depends on FEAT-001 (JanaChatBubble, JanaAvatar, JanaStateViews, strings, teacherDisplayName, CheckoutSession.itemId). The profile tab itself is FEAT-003; after this FEAT the chat screen is reachable only by route. Full spec: plan item 2 in d:/AndroidApps/JANA/JANA/.agents/tasks/teacher_plan.md.
steps: Read plan item 2 and the 'Routes and navigation' + 'Koin' sections of d:/AndroidApps/JANA/JANA/.agents/tasks/teacher_plan.md.

Create the domain under feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/teacher/domain/. model/TeacherProfile.kt holds TeacherProfile(id, name, gender: com.hussein.jana.feature.home.TeacherGender, subject, bio, photoUrl: String?). model/TeacherSubscription.kt holds enum SubscriptionStatus { ACTIVE, EXPIRED, NOT_SUBSCRIBED } and TeacherSubscription(planId, planName, status, expiresAtMs: Long?, price: Money?) with isPurchasable = status != ACTIVE && price != null. model/ChatMessage.kt holds ChatMessage(id, text, sentAtMs, isFromStudent, isRead). Repository interfaces: TeacherProfileRepository.getActiveTeacherProfile(); TeacherSubscriptionRepository.getLiveLessonsSubscription() / createLiveSubscriptionCheckout(planId, method: PaymentMethod): Result<CheckoutSession> / verifyLiveSubscriptionPayment(checkoutId): Result<PaymentVerification> (reuse the models in tabs/courses/domain/model/Payment.kt); TeacherChatRepository.getMessages() / sendMessage(text).

Create the use cases in tabs/teacher/domain/usecase/, following GetCoursesUseCase: GetActiveTeacherProfileUseCase, GetLiveLessonsSubscriptionUseCase, CreateLiveSubscriptionCheckoutUseCase, VerifyLiveSubscriptionPaymentUseCase, GetTeacherChatMessagesUseCase, SendTeacherMessageUseCase (trim; blank → Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException)), and GetTeacherUpcomingLessonsUseCase(LiveLessonRepository). The last one calls getUpcomingLiveLessons() and getNextLiveLessons(), fails if either fails, and otherwise returns (upcoming + next).distinctBy { it.id } with LIVE_NOW first and the rest sorted by startEpochMs.

Create tabs/teacher/data/mock/MockTeacherData.kt (internal object): profile id 'teacher_active', name 'Ahmed', TeacherGender.MALE, subject 'Mathematics', a short bio, photoUrl 'https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12'; live plan planId 'live_monthly', planName 'Monthly live lessons', NOT_SUBSCRIBED, expiresAtMs null, Money(200.0, "EGP"); fun seedMessages(nowMs: Long): List<ChatMessage> with 4 mixed-sender messages.

Create tabs/teacher/data/repository/TeacherProfileRepositoryImpl.kt (delay(400); '// TODO: replace with real API call — GET /api/v1/me/platform and GET /api/v1/me/branding' + '// TODO: multi-account ActiveTeacherContext'). Create TeacherSubscriptionRepositoryImpl.kt modelled on CoursePaymentRepositoryImpl: in-memory subscription, sessions map and counter. get = delay(400) with TODO GET /api/v1/me/subscriptions. createLiveSubscriptionCheckout = delay(600), fails for an unknown planId or null price, builds CheckoutSession(itemId = planId, ...), TODO GET /api/v1/subscriptions/plans + POST /api/v1/subscriptions/{planId}/checkout. verifyLiveSubscriptionPayment = delay(800); an unknown session returns FAILED; otherwise it sets status ACTIVE with expiresAtMs = now + 30 days (the ONLY activation point), TODO POST /api/v1/payments/{id}/verify. Get now via kotlin.time.Clock.System.now().toEpochMilliseconds() with @OptIn(ExperimentalTime::class), as in tabs/home/HomeTabViewModel.kt. Create TeacherChatRepositoryImpl.kt: a list seeded from MockTeacherData; getMessages delay(300); sendMessage delay(300) appends and returns a student message; comment '// TODO: replace with real API / WebSocket — GET /api/v1/conversations, GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages, POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages'.
Add a TODO comment in HomeViewModel.kt saying teacherName/gender/subject should come from GetActiveTeacherProfileUseCase. Do NOT change its constructor (HomeViewModelTest builds HomeViewModel()).

Create tabs/teacher/presentation/common/TimeFormatting.kt with internal formatShortDate(epochMs): String ('dd/MM/yyyy') and formatTimeOfDay(epochMs): String ('HH:mm'), using kotlinx.datetime Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds + toLocalDateTime(TimeZone.currentSystemDefault()) + padStart.

Create tabs/teacher/presentation/chat/TeacherChatContract.kt. TeacherChatUiState(isLoading = true, teacher: TeacherProfile? = null, messages = emptyList(), input = "", isSending = false, error: String? = null) has canSend = input.isNotBlank() && !isSending. Intents: Load, InputChanged(text), Send, Back. Effects: NavigateBack, ShowSendFailed.

Create TeacherChatViewModel(getActiveTeacherProfile, getTeacherChatMessages, sendTeacherMessage): BaseMviViewModel. init → Load (async profile + messages; either failure sets error). InputChanged updates input. Send is ignored unless canSend; it sets isSending, then on success appends the message and clears input, and on failure keeps input and emits ShowSendFailed. Back → NavigateBack.

Create TeacherChatScreen.kt. TeacherChatScreen(onBack, viewModel: TeacherChatViewModel = koinViewModel()) collects effects (NavigateBack → onBack(); ShowSendFailed → snackbar teacher_chat_send_failed) and calls the stateless TeacherChatContent(state, snackbarHostState, onBack, onIntent). Its Scaffold has a TopAppBar (navigationIcon Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack with cd nav_back; title Row of JanaAvatar(size 36.dp) + teacherDisplayName(name, gender), or teacher_chat_title while teacher is null; containerColor colorScheme.background), a snackbarHost, and a bottomBar JanaChatInput(text = state.input, onTextChange → InputChanged, onSendClick → Send, hint = teacher_chat_input_hint, enabled = !state.isSending) inside a Box with .navigationBarsPadding().imePadding().padding(horizontal 16.dp, vertical 8.dp). Body: loading → JanaLoadingState; error → JanaErrorState(error_generic, btn_retry) → Load; empty → JanaEmptyState(teacher_chat_empty); else LazyColumn(reverseLayout = true, spacedBy 8.dp, vertical contentPadding 12.dp) over state.messages.asReversed() keyed by id → JanaChatBubble(text, formatTimeOfDay(sentAtMs), isOutgoing = isFromStudent).

In core/navigation/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/core/navigation/Routes.kt add '@Serializable data object TeacherChat : HomeRoute' with a KDoc noting the conversation is with the active teacher, so no id. In HomeEntryProvider.kt add the 'is HomeRoute.TeacherChat ->' entry: koinInject AppNavigator and call TeacherChatScreen(onBack = { navigator.back() }).

Create tabs/teacher/di/TeacherModule.kt (val teacherModule) with singleOf(...) bind for the 3 repositories, factoryOf for the 7 use cases and viewModel { TeacherChatViewModel(get(), get(), get()) }. In di/HomeModule.kt change to includes(liveLessonsModule, coursesModule, teacherModule).
Run verification commands. Commit by name (nothing under .agents/): 'feat: teacher domain, mock repositories and teacher chat screen'.
